replies.body:
Thanks, really appreciate that! For the animations, it been very straight forward in this specific case, it was mainly Claude. Did a bit of back and forth to get the timing right, especially for the boss stomping animation.  
20K wishlists would be awesome but honestly, I feel the steam community would trash it. There’s a lot of AI involved in this and that can be a pretty sensitive topic over there 😅
